full_judgment: 14. In the instant case, nothing had been mentioned in the order sheet of the suit about the report from the process server as to whether the Sonali Bank, the defendant No.2, is available in the address given in the plaint or whether its officials refused to accept the summons nothing of the sort has been mentioned, rather order-sheet gives an impression that no effort was taken to serve the summons through process server. Besides, the postal receipt for sending the summons by post does not appear to have been filed, denying the presumption of service by post.
